title: understand unfold v1
description: The results of the pass unfold (corpus arxiv AX7.5): the self-contained form of each item, in TeX, with what it inlined from the context, the terms it left as standard background and the places where it had to choose.

id.description: the id of the item, as ax://paper/2401.00001#A1B2

unfolded.description: the item as one self-contained text in TeX, with no item named by its number and no macro of the paper

inlined.description: each part of the context that the unfolded form took

item.description: the id of the item that the part is from, or empty for a part with no item

part.description: which part, as the hypotheses (a) and (b), or the term tame

assumed.description: the terms left as standard background, as Noetherian ring

notes.description: each place where the unfolding had to choose
